CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  OCTOBER 9, 2018

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Winterer at 4:33 p.m., on
Tuesday, October 9, 2018, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich (arrived at 4:35 p.m.)
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Pam O’Connor
  Councilmember Terry O’Day

  Absent:  Councilmember Tony Vazquez

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:33 p.m., with all
Councilmember Himmelrich  members present except Councilmember Vazquez.
arrived at 4:35 p.m.

CLOSED SESSIONS  Member of the public Denise Barton commented on Closed Session.

  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:36 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 5:34 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  1.A.  Public Employee Evaluation Title: City Manager

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the Special City Council meeting adjourned at 5:34
  p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Ted Winterer
  Ted Winterer (Feb 19, 2019)

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ted Winterer
  City Clerk  Mayor
